title: Experiments and Feature Flags Now Available on Free and Growth Plans with Full Enterprise Features
summary: Experiments and feature flags are now available on Free and Growth plans with full enterprise features for optimized testing.
body_markdown:
🧪


⛳


Experiments and feature flags are now on Free and Growth!


⛳


🧪


Hey everyone, I'm super excited to announce that experiments and feature flags are now available for customers on our self-serve plans.


Details:


-


Free:


1,000 Monthly Experiment Users (MEU), up to 10 active feature flags included


-


Growth:


5,000 MEU/month, up to 50 active feature flags included


-


Can add up to 100k MEU (you'll also get 500 active flags if you add more MEU)


You can get started


right now.


Simply login, navigate to experiments or feature flags on the left nav, and start testing and shipping! Looking for help? Check out our


[Experiment & Optimize tour](https://docs.mixpanel.com/guides/self-guided-tours#experiment-&-optimize) ,


[Experiments docs](https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/experiments) ,


[Feature Flags docs](https://docs.mixpanel.com/docs/featureflags) , a


[quick demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o7zyzQoo7Oc) , and our


[Changelog](https://docs.mixpanel.com/changelogs) . I'm happy to say that both come with


full feature parity of our Enterprise plan


, meaning you can:


-


Move at the speed of AI:


Full MCP and Mixpanel Agent support means your AI assistant can propose tests from live metrics, launch them, and interpret the results — no context switching, no advanced stats knowledge required.


-


Trust every result:


Pre-Experiment Bias and SRM checks run automatically, and advanced methodologies like CUPED, Winsorization, Bonferroni, Benjamini-Hochberg are available to keep every experiment statistically sound


-


Target by behavior, not just identity:


Roll out to the cohorts and events you already use in Mixpanel.


-


Ship with control:


Audit trails, multi-environment support, and dynamic config are all included.


As you get going, we'd love to hear from you; feel free to drop what you're working on (or any questions) in the thread


🧵


!
